tenants.title: Tenant workspace
tenants.description: Manage companies and enter a tenant workspace for investigation.
tenants.firstAdminHint: Creates the company's first user, who signs in with this email and manages the tenant. You can also add users later from Users.
tenants.adminRoleMissing: The tenant administrator role was not found.
tenants.registeredWithAdmin: Tenant registered. {email} can sign in as its administrator.
tenants.adminNotCreated: Tenant registered, but the administrator was not created: {reason}. Add it from Users.

tenantUsers.title: Users · {tenant}
tenantUsers.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Share it securely; the user should change it.
tenantUsers.companyHint: All companies: a tenant user who switches between companies (usual for the first administrator).
tenantUsers.empty: This tenant has no users yet
tenantUsers.noAdminText: Add one so the company can manage its own users and settings.
tenantUsers.deactivateHint: They will no longer be able to sign in.

users.title: Users
users.description: Control who can access this tenant and their assigned role.
users.employeeRequiredHint: Every tenant user must be linked to one active employee.
users.companyCreateHint: A company user sees only that company's jobs, documents and reports. Tenant users switch between companies.
users.companyMoveHint: Customers, employees and other masters are shared; jobs, documents and reports are per company.
users.linkHint: Each employee can be linked to only one user. The user must sign in again after this change.
users.companySaved: Company access saved. It applies to the user's next request.
users.employeeLinked: Employee linked. The user must sign in again to refresh access.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Review default access or create a tailored permission set.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: A chronological, immutable record of data changes in this tenant.
audit.searchPlaceholder: Search actor, entity, ID or action

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Each company keeps its own jobs, documents, numbering, books, reports and letterhead. Customers, employees and other masters are shared by all companies.
companies.whoWorksWhereText: Users assigned to a company see only that company. Tenant users (no company) switch between companies from the side menu. Set a user's company on the Users page.
companies.makeDefaultHint: Tenant users open it first, and background work is recorded in it.
companies.deactivateHint: Its users cannot sign in until it is active again. Its records are kept.
companies.legalNameHint: Printed on documents when the letterhead has no company name.
companies.numberCodeHint: Added to this company's document numbers (QT-DXB-20261011-000001), so every company has its own series. Only one company can use plain numbers.

designations.title: Designation master
designations.description: Define the reporting levels and positions used by your workforce.
designations.name: Designation name
designations.levelHint: Level 1 is the highest organizational level.
designations.salesmanCheckbox: Salesman designation — restrict linked users to their own quotations
designations.codeRule: Use letters, numbers, underscore or hyphen

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Manage employee records and a validated reporting structure.
employees.searchPlaceholder: Search employee, number, email or phone
employees.reportsToHint: Only higher-level active employees are available.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.description: Your overdue and due-today work, gathered from every module in one place.
myTasks.emptyNote: Follow-ups appear here when the assigned employee’s work email matches the signed-in user.
